text: Settled frame 4.1× the baseline (5.67 → 1.37 s, headless), moving frames 35× (full resolution, from the baked field). Every settled pixel now does ~6.5 exact field evaluations of ~6 objects each, only round the baked hit. Exact-field agent still working on the cost of each evaluation. Next: fewer objects per evaluation (finer pruning near the hit), cheaper sweeps, then the scaling sweep and stress scenes.
noise: Noise: 5 baseline runs of the composite scene, 5552–5777 ms (σ ≈ 1.5%). A change must beat the incumbent by > 3% and hold on a confirmation run.
